rows.note: Use this for the physical supporting base of a building or structure.

example.english: The building’s foundation was laid solidly, so it can withstand any amount of rain.
example.traditional: 棟樓嘅地基打得好實淨，落幾多雨都唔怕。
example.jyutping: dung6 lau4 ge3 dei6 gei1 daa2 dak1 hou2 sat6 zing6 lok6 gei2 do1 jyu5 dou1 m4 paa3

rows.note: Use this for cosmetic foundation applied to the face.

example.english: This foundation blends well and does not melt easily even when I sweat.
example.traditional: 呢隻粉底好貼面，出汗都唔易溶。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 fan2 dai2 hou2 tip3 min6 ceot1 hon6 dou1 m4 ji6 jung4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an abstract foundation or basis that supports further development.

example.english: This plan lays a solid foundation for the company's future development.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃為公司未來發展打好基礎。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 wai6 gung1 si1 mei6 loi4 faat3 zin2 daa2 hou2 gei1 co2

rows.note: Use this for an endowed foundation or charitable organization.

example.english: This foundation helps many grassroots families every year.
example.traditional: 呢間基金會每年都幫好多基層家庭。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gei1 gam1 wui6 mui5 nin4 dou1 bong1 hou2 do1 gei1 cang4 gaa1 ting4
